query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Manage Salesforce leads, contacts, campaign membership, campaign attendance statuses, a campaign-based static list, and MQL lead activity reporting.
query_ground_truth.query: look up a campaign using the title in salesforce
query_ground_truth.rationale: Locating the correct campaign is a prerequisite for adding contacts and managing campaign attendance statuses or static lists.

results.use_case: look up a campaign using the title in salesforce
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Identify the intended person record using SALESFORCE_SEARCH_CONTACTS (filter by associated organization; request only key disambiguation fields including the related organization field).
[Optional (if multiple matches)] [Prerequisite]: Confirm the selected person using SALESFORCE_GET_CONTACT (verify identifiers before any write).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Identify the target campaign using SALESFORCE_SEARCH_CAMPAIGNS (skip if campaign identifier is already known; otherwise capture the campaign identifier).
[Optional (if multiple matches)] [Prerequisite]: Confirm the selected campaign using SALESFORCE_GET_CAMPAIGN (ensure the intended campaign before any write).
[Optional (if duplicate prevention required)] [Prerequisite]: Check existing membership using SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY (query CampaignMember by both person identifier and campaign identifier).
[Required] [Step]: Create membership using SALESFORCE_ADD_CONTACT_TO_CAMPAIGN (only after confirming the chosen person and campaign).
[Optional (if creating many memberships)] [Step]: Batch-create CampaignMember records using SALESFORCE_POST_COMPOSITE_SOBJECTS (reduce many single-write calls).
[Optional (if an incorrect membership was created)] [Fallback]: Undo by removing it using SALESFORCE_REMOVE_FROM_CAMPAIGN.
known_pitfalls: [SALESFORCE_SEARCH_CONTACTS] Related organization data may be missing unless explicitly requested as a relationship field in the returned field set.
[SALESFORCE_SEARCH_CAMPAIGNS] Name-based search can return near-duplicate results; treat output as candidates and require explicit selection before writes.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] Some membership pre-check approaches can fail with HTTP 400; run the CampaignMember SOQL directly with this tool.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] Selecting unsupported relationship fields can fail with INVALID_FIELD; query only fields available on the target object.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] Aggregate count-style queries may return records=[] while the count is present elsewhere in the response; verify the count field before concluding “no matches.”

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Salesforce is a leading CRM platform integrating sales, service, marketing, and analytics to build customer relationships and drive business growth
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=salesforce. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="salesforce") to create a connection BEFORE executing any salesforce tools.

SALESFORCE_SEARCH_CONTACTS.description: Search Salesforce Contact records (not Leads — use SALESFORCE_SEARCH_LEADS for those) using name, email, phone, account, or title. All parameters support partial/fuzzy matching, so results may include unrelated records; post-filter client-side for exact matches. Partial matches and common names can return multiple contacts — always confirm the correct contact by its 18-character Id before passing to write operations like SALESFORCE_LOG_CALL or SALESFORCE_CREATE_TASK. A response with totalSize=0 is a valid 'not found' outcome. Provide at least one search criterion; omitting all returns a broad, slow result set. Returned Ids are 18-character strings and must be used as-is in downstream tools.

name.description: Search by contact name (first name, last name, or full name). Supports partial matches.

email.description: Search by email address. Supports partial matches.

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return. Maximum allowed is 2000; when totalSize exceeds limit, paginate to retrieve full results.

phone.description: Search by phone number. Supports partial matches.

title.description: Search by job title. Supports partial matches.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of Contact fields to retrieve. Custom and non-default fields are excluded unless explicitly listed here.

account_name.description: Search by associated account name. Supports partial matches.

SALESFORCE_SEARCH_CAMPAIGNS.description: Search for Salesforce campaigns using multiple criteria like name, type, status, date range, or active status. Requires access to the Campaign object (Marketing User feature must be enabled in the org). For complex sorting (multi-field ORDER BY), use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY instead.

name.description: Search by campaign name. Supports partial matches. Combine with type, status, or date range filters to narrow results when names are non-unique.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return. Check totalSize in the response to determine if results are truncated; issue additional queries if needed.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of Campaign fields to retrieve.

is_active.description: Filter by active status. True for active campaigns, False for inactive.

start_date_to.description: Upper bound for StartDate (inclusive). Use YYYY-MM-DD.

start_date_from.description: Lower bound for StartDate (inclusive). Use YYYY-MM-DD.

SALESFORCE_ADD_CONTACT_TO_CAMPAIGN.description: Adds a contact to a campaign by creating a CampaignMember record to track campaign engagement. Fails if the contact is already a member of the campaign; pre-check membership via SOQL before calling.

status.description: The status of the campaign member. Common values include 'Sent', 'Responded'. The available statuses depend on campaign configuration. Value must exactly match a configured CampaignMember Status for the campaign; arbitrary strings will fail. Query the campaign's CampaignMemberStatus records first if unsure of valid values.

contact_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the contact to add to the campaign.

campaign_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the campaign to add the contact to.

custom_fields.description: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values for CampaignMember. Custom field names typically end with '__c'.

SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY.description: Executes a SOQL query against Salesforce data. Returns records matching the query with pagination support.

examples: SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact WHERE CreatedDate > 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z
SELECT Name, (SELECT LastName FROM Contacts) FROM Account
SELECT COUNT() FROM Lead WHERE Status = 'New'
SELECT COUNT(Id), StageName FROM Opportunity GROUP BY StageName
SELECT Id, Name FROM Opportunity ORDER BY Amount DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT Id, Name FROM Contact WHERE LastName = 'O\'Brien'
SELECT Id, Name, Description FROM Account LIMIT 10
query.description: SOQL query to execute. Must start with SELECT. Field names must match object schema exactly — use SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT for unfamiliar objects. ALIASES: No 'AS' keyword (use 'SUM(Amount) TotalSales' NOT 'SUM(Amount) AS TotalSales'). AGGREGATES: Without GROUP BY, ORDER BY/LIMIT not allowed (single-row result). COUNT() SYNTAX: Bare COUNT() only valid alone. With GROUP BY or other fields, must specify field: COUNT(Id) or COUNT(fieldName). Example: 'SELECT COUNT(Id), Status FROM Lead GROUP BY Status' NOT 'SELECT COUNT(), Status FROM Lead GROUP BY Status'. NON-GROUPABLE: Long text, rich text, encrypted text, compound address/location fields. NON-FILTERABLE: Long text area, rich text, encrypted text, multi-select picklists, blob fields CANNOT be in WHERE. FIELDS(ALL)/FIELDS(CUSTOM) require LIMIT ≤200. ID values need single quotes. Apostrophes use backslash: 'O\'Brien'.

SALESFORCE_GET_CONTACT.description: Retrieves a specific contact by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

SALESFORCE_GET_CAMPAIGN.description: Retrieves a specific campaign by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.
